newsitem.title: USA: Light quake jolts northern California.
newsitem.headline: Light quake jolts northern California.

text.p: A light earthquake jolted northern California on Wednesday but local officials said there were no immediate reports of injuries or damage.

The quake, measuring 4.1 on the open-ended Richter scale, struck at 1:21 p.m. local time (1921 GMT) just north-northeast of Healdsburg in Sonoma County, located about 60 miles (96 km) north of San Francisco, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.
"It's a very common area to have earthquakes," said Lu Page, a spokeswoman for the U.S. Geological Survey.
A Sonoma County sheriff's dispatcher said local authorities have received no reports of injuries or damage since the quake.
